paragraphs.source_en: Roque turns to me, face drawn, terrified.

units.source_en: Roque turns to me, face drawn, terrified.

paragraphs.source_en: “Flee,” he manages just as the red signal burns back to life.

units.source_en: “Flee,” he manages just as the red signal burns back to life.

paragraphs.source_en: “Full power to engines,” I roar. “Thirty degrees plus our midline.”

units.source_en: “Full power to engines,” I roar.
“Thirty degrees plus our midline.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Launch remaining missiles at the surface of the asteroid,” Tactus commands.

units.source_en: “Launch remaining missiles at the surface of the asteroid,” Tactus commands.
Too late.

paragraphs.source_en: Victra gasps, and I see with my naked eyes what our instruments struggled to detect. One shadowed destroyer emerges from a hollow in the asteroid. A ship I thought we defeated three days ago. Its engines were off as it lay in wait. Its front half is torn and black from damage. Now its engines blast at full power. And its trajectory takes it directly toward my ship.

units.source_en: Victra gasps, and I see with my naked eyes what our instruments struggled to detect.

ja.t: えようとしていたものを

units.source_en: One shadowed destroyer emerges from a hollow in the asteroid.
A ship I thought we defeated three days ago.
Its engines were off as it lay in wait.

ja.t: せのあいだ、そいつはエンジンを

units.source_en: Its front half is torn and black from damage.
Now its engines blast at full power.
And its trajectory takes it directly toward my ship.
It’s going to ram us.

paragraphs.source_en: “Evac suits and pods!” I shout. Someone’s screaming for us to brace for impact. I rush to the side of the bridge where my command escape pod is built into the wall. It opens at my word. Tactus, Roque, and Victra sprint into its confines. I hold back, shouting at the Blues to hurry and unsync. For all their logic, they’ll die for their ships.

units.source_en: “Evac suits and pods!”
I shout.
Someone’s screaming for us to brace for impact.
I rush to the side of the bridge where my command escape pod is built into the wall.
It opens at my word.
Tactus, Roque, and Victra sprint into its confines.

ja.t: タクタス、ロック、ヴィクトラがその

units.source_en: I hold back, shouting at the Blues to hurry and unsync.
For all their logic, they’ll die for their ships.

paragraphs.source_en: I range about the bridge, screaming at them to activate their escape hatch. The helmBlue does, pressing a button that causes a hole to dilate in the floor of the pit. One by one, they unsync and are sucked down the gravity tube into their escape pods.

units.source_en: I range about the bridge, screaming at them to activate their escape hatch.
The helmBlue does, pressing a button that causes a hole to dilate in the floor of the pit.
One by one, they unsync and are sucked down the gravity tube into their escape pods.

paragraphs.source_en: “Theodora!” I shout, seeing her prying at a young Blue who still clutches his operations display with white-knuckled fear. “Get in the gorydamn pod!” She doesn’t listen. Neither does the Blue let go. I start toward them just as the proximity sensor lets loose one final warning blast.

units.source_en: “Theodora!”
I shout, seeing her prying at a young Blue who still clutches his operations display with white-knuckled fear.

ja.t: きはがそうとしていた。

units.source_en: “Get in the gorydamn pod!”
She doesn’t listen.
Neither does the Blue let go.
I start toward them just as the proximity sensor lets loose one final warning blast.
All slows.
Bridge lights throb red.

paragraphs.source_en: I jump for Theodora, wrapping my arms around her.

units.source_en: I jump for Theodora, wrapping my arms around her.

paragraphs.source_en: And the destroyer hits my man-of-war at her midline.

units.source_en: And the destroyer hits my man-of-war at her midline.

paragraphs.source_en: Clutching Theodora to my chest, I’m thrown thirty meters across my bridge, slamming into a metal wall. White pain rips across my left arm along the seams of the mending break. I’m slapped with darkness. Lights dance there, first like stars, then as weaving lines of sand disturbed by wind.

units.source_en: Clutching Theodora to my chest, I’m thrown thirty meters across my bridge, slamming into a metal wall.
White pain rips across my left arm along the seams of the mending break.
I’m slapped with darkness.
Lights dance there, first like stars, then as weaving lines of sand disturbed by wind.

paragraphs.source_en: Red light seeps through my eyelids. A gentle hand pulls at my clothing.

units.source_en: Red light seeps through my eyelids.
A gentle hand pulls at my clothing.

paragraphs.source_en: I open my eyes. I’m wrapped around a dented electrical column as the ship shudders, groaning like an ancient, dying beast sinking in the deep. The column trembles violently against my stomach as the destroyer finishes sheaving through our middle. Gutting us with slow cruelty.

ja.t: のようにうめいている。

paragraphs.source_en: Someone’s shouting my name. Sound fades back into being.
